failureBasis.failure: After the negative override restore failed, the always-run artifact uploader could not open release/evidence/result.json: EACCES. The existing atomic_json uses a root-owned temporary file in the SDK container, whose0600 mode remains when atomically replaced.

scope.operation: sudo chown -R --no-dereference to the current host runner UID:GID, only when each explicitly listed directory exists.
scope.outsideScope: Working feeds/packages, private test keys, test databases, caches, source checkout and transferred runtime bundles are not targeted. Public artifacts/packages is not targeted; existing evidence upload path declarations remain unchanged.
scope.hashBoundary: Ownership/ctime metadata may change, but no file content, JSON encoding, archive member, expected SHA or package identity is rewritten. Existing evidence hashes are content hashes and remain applicable.

checks: The new step has if:always() and precedes the existing if:always() uploader, so it remains eligible after the observed Task-07 failure instead of being skipped by the normal success condition.
A normal earlier build/consumer failure is not caught or changed to success. The job still fails; the separate exact verified candidate upload retains its default success condition.

The fixed four-path allowlist covers the failed release/evidence/result.json and all other declared container-produced evidence directories without recursively changing ownership of the whole B24 work directory.

The host runner becomes owner of root-created0600 files and can read them without chmod or broadening their mode. sudo also permits checking/traversing the explicitly listed root-owned evidence directories.

GNU chown --no-dereference changes a symlink itself rather than its referent. Its default recursive traversal is-P because-H/-L are absent, so this command does not follow directory symlinks out of the evidence hierarchy. This was confirmed from local chown --help without performing chown.

Missing evidence directories are skipped, which allows evidence retention after failures that occur before a later stage creates its output. A real chown error is not silently converted into a successful upload.
